narrative: Free will is reframed not as the exception to physics but as its most fundamental feature: the irreducible self-determination present at every scale where possibility resolves into actuality, not only in minds. Drawing on Whitehead's process philosophy, the chapter argues that the creative advance into novelty is the basic character of reality, dissolving the traditional free will debate by rejecting the premise that physics is deterministic and freedom is the anomaly.
